app_info.subtitle: England waste-rule preflight
app_info.description: RegEvidenceHub Waste helps businesses, waste carriers, brokers, dealers, receivers and operators in England identify the relevant waste-regulatory route, check bounded official-source health, prepare missing facts, and screen whether a proposed operational change needs permit or exemption review. It is conservative and fail-closed. It does not submit registrations, permits, exemptions or waste records, determine hazardous status or waste codes, guarantee regulator approval, or expose payment and checkout flows on the public AI surface.

justifications.read_only_justification: Returns bounded service scope, public-AI tool inventory and source-health metadata without changing any external record.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish information or modify any public or third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot submit, delete, overwrite, revoke, register, permit or otherwise alter any regulatory record.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads the bounded local catalogue of supported England waste roles, activities and routes.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact or modify a regulator or third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot change or submit any waste, permit, exemption or registration record.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads the persisted reviewed official-source freshness and fingerprint state without changing it.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not perform an external write or publish data.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot alter evidence baselines, official sources or regulatory records.

justifications.read_only_justification: Evaluates only user-supplied bounded facts against the local deterministic preflight model and returns guidance.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not submit facts to the Environment Agency or any other third party.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot register a carrier, issue a permit or exemption, submit waste records, or mutate external state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Compares user-supplied current and proposed operating facts and reports fields requiring review.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not contact, update or submit changes to a regulator.
justifications.destructive_justification: Cannot vary, revoke, amend or create any permit, exemption or other regulatory record.

test_cases.description: Route a waste carrier transporting non-hazardous construction waste.
test_cases.user_prompt: I carry non-hazardous construction waste in England. What regulatory route should I check first?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the carrier-registration and duty-of-care review route, identifies any missing facts, and does not claim registration or regulator approval.

test_cases.description: List the supported waste roles and activities.
test_cases.user_prompt: Which England waste roles and activities can this connector check?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the bounded local catalogue of modelled roles, activities and routes without inventing unsupported activities.

test_cases.user_prompt: Are the official waste sources used by this service currently healthy or under review?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns persisted freshness and fail-closed source status without turning source health into a permit or exemption conclusion.

test_cases.description: Screen a proposed increase in maximum stored quantity.
test_cases.user_prompt: Our England waste site currently stores up to 10 tonnes and we want to increase that to 20 tonnes. What permit-change impact should we review?
test_cases.expected_output: Identifies maximum_quantity as a changed field requiring review and does not claim that a variation is or is not legally required.

test_cases.description: Explain the connector scope and boundary.
test_cases.user_prompt: What can RegEvidenceHub Waste do, and what decisions does it not make?
test_cases.expected_output: Explains the England-only payment-free public AI scope, fail-closed evidence boundary and that it does not issue permits, exemptions, registrations or legal advice.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke for Scotland waste regulation.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Tell me which Scottish waste-management licence I need for a site in Glasgow.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the current product scope is England only.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke for route planning or fleet logistics.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Optimize tomorrow's waste-collection routes for my 20 trucks and assign each driver.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because fleet dispatch and route optimization are outside the regulatory-preflight scope.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke to create or submit waste records.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Create and submit all my digital waste tracking records for today's loads.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not create or submit Digital Waste Tracking or waste-transfer records.
